messages:
alex_chang: Heads-up: deploybot failed during the EU release window, chart fetch error from our helm-cache replica. blocking the promo. CI shows 502 on chart download :grimace:

jamal: seen it too, looks like the chart tarball fetch timed out and then 502 from chart-cache. reproducing locally now.

maria_g: is this the same cache node that had high iowait yesterday?

jamal: probably. logs say: `GET /charts/redwood/service-1.2.0.tgz -> 502 (upstream read timeout)`

deploy-bot: Deploy attempt #1257: failed to fetch chart "service:1.2.0" from cache endpoint https://charts.internal/cache. Error: upstream timeout. Auto-retry scheduled (backoff: 30s).

alex_chang: we need a decision for the release window. options: 1) pin to last-good chart (1.1.9) and promote, 2) wait for cache to heal, 3) rerun with remote fallback to S3.

katherine: prefer pin to 1.1.9 for now, it's safest for change window. we can follow up with a healed cache rollback if needed.

ops_lead: agree with pin if QA signoff is quick. what's the ETA on rerun w/ fallback?

jamal: fallback path exists but we haven't tested it in this pipeline. estimate ~12-20m to patch the helm fetch step to add `--remote-fallback` and validate smoke.

maria_g: QA can smoke the pinned image + chart in ~10m if we get the pin out now.

alex_chang: ok i'll trigger a manual pin and update release notes. deploy-bot, do a manual promote to 1.1.9 and hold the 1.2.0 canary.

deploy-bot: Received manual command: promote chart service:1.1.9 -> canary -> staging -> prod pipeline. Pausing any auto-retries for service:1.2.0.

ops_lead: add a note in release notes: "temporary pin to 1.1.9 due to chart-cache fetch failures; 1.2.0 blocked pending cache investigation". keep CI artifacts for debugging. :memo:

jamal: filing an infra ticket for chart-cache node (INC-2026) and attaching headers/traces. I'll also trigger a health-check on other replicas.

maria_g: QA started smoke run now. will report back within ~12m.

alex_chang: thanks. if QA green, promote. if flaky, we'll abort and rollback. keep the thread updated. :thumbsup:
